battle.name: 秦朝
battle.brief: 公元前209年七月，陳涉、吳廣率九百戍卒在大澤鄉起事，旬月之間車六七百乘席捲陳郡，張楚政權一度立起；同年秦將章邯出關迎擊，周文與陳涉兩軍在曹陽對撞，秦朝就此崩解。卡面亞述長弓不屬秦軍裝備，它源於更早的兩河反曲複合弓；秦軍的弩機與兵車，是同一邏輯的另一種形態。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 公元前209年秦末，交戰雙方是秦朝中央政府與起義聯軍。秦方是剛完成統一、尚未消化六國的中央集權國家：皇帝之下設丞相、太尉、御史大夫三公與九卿，地方行郡縣制，軍隊分為關中宿衛、鎮守郡縣的郡兵、戍守北邊的邊軍與南疆五嶺的戍卒四類，軍令由丞相府與掌樞密之權的趙高傳達，郡縣官吏就地徵發與徵調。起義方則是由陳涉、吳廣首倡、旬月之間自大澤鄉席捲陳郡的農民軍，攻陳之後立號「張楚」，設王、設將軍，兵分數路：周文西向關中，武臣、張耳、陳餘北略趙地，韓廣往燕地；楚地六國舊地隨即響應，秦縣令秦嘉、秦廷博士孔鮑（魯國孔甲之後）各聚眾而起。聯軍靠號召而非編制維繫，無統一將令、無後方根據地，各路自行其是，遇強敵往往各自潰散，與秦軍可以集中調度、統一補給的樣態形成對照。
countriesEn: In 209 BC, at the end of the Qin, the belligerents were the government of the Qin court and the rebel coalition. The Qin side was a centralised state that had only just completed the unification and had not yet digested the six conquered kingdoms: under the emperor stood the three ministers and the nine ministers of court, and in the provinces the commandery-and-county system, with the army divided into the palace guard of the capital, the county levies that garrisoned the cities, the frontier army that guarded the northern border, and the garrisons of the Five Ridges in the far south. Orders travelled from the office of the chancellor and from Zhao Gao, who held the key to the palace; local officials levied and mustered on the spot. The rebel side was the peasant army led by Chen Sheng and Wu Guang, which had swept from Daze township into the commandery of Chen within a month; after taking the city they proclaimed a king and set up generals, and split their force into several columns: Zhou Wen west toward the passes of Guanzhong, Wu Chen, Zhang Er and Chen Yu north into the lands of Zhao, and Han Guang toward Yan. The old territories of Chu and the other former kingdoms rose in answer almost at once, with the magistrate of Qin county, Qin Jia, and the Lu scholar Kong Fu each gathering a following of their own. What held the coalition together was a slogan rather than an establishment: there was no united command and no rear base, each column acted on its own initiative, and a strong enemy in front usually meant separate routs, in sharp contrast to the Qin, which could concentrate and move its troops and feed them from a single line.
people: 這場戰爭的關鍵人物多來自底層與幕府兩端。首義者是陽城人陳涉與同里吳廣，兩人出身貧苦農戶，同為戍卒，見秦法「失期法皆斬」，遂商議「舉大計亦死，等死，死國可乎」，以狐鳴魚腹的方式宣稱天意，攻陳之後自立為王，號「張楚」。秦方的主將是章邯，他臨危受命，率兵出關迎擊西進的周文於曹陽，再回師攻陳；朝中樞要為丞相李斯與兼行中尉事的趙高，李斯是荀卿弟子，起義時仍居丞相之位，其後才被趙高構陷，與二世同死於咸陽，趙高則是真正左右軍政的人。北方邊軍主帥蒙恬與長兄扶蘇、蒙毅在起義之前已被賜死，留在上郡的邊軍頓時失去主帥，這是秦廷的深傷。周文、范增、張耳、陳餘、武臣、韓廣、秦嘉、孔鮑等人則分別代表起義軍的西征線、趙地線與燕地線。
peopleEn: The key figures of this war came from the bottom of society and from the two ends of the command tent. The initiators were Chen Sheng of Yangcheng and Wu Guang, a fellow villager; both were born into poor farming households and were both conscripted soldiers. Seeing that Qin law left no escape for a column that missed its deadline, they argued that to rise in arms was also death, but to die in a rising was death with a purpose, and they announced heaven's will by the fox's cry and the writing in the fish, then took the city of Chen and set themselves up as king with the title Zhangchu. On the Qin side the commander was Zhang Han, who was given charge in the crisis, marched out of the passes to meet Zhou Wen at Caoyang, and then turned back to attack Chen. The men who held the centre of power at court were the chancellor Li Si, a disciple of Xunzi, who was still chancellor when the rising began and was only later framed by Zhao Gao and killed together with the Second Emperor at Xianyang, and Zhao Gao himself, who really directed the war and the government. The commander of the northern frontier, Meng Tian, had been put to death with the crown prince Fusu and with Meng Yi before the rising; the army of thirty thousand left behind at Shangjun was at once without a general, and that was a deep wound in the Qin court. Zhou Wen, Fan Zeng, Zhang Er, Chen Yu, Wu Chen, Han Guang, Qin Jia and Kong Fu each stood for one of the rebel lines: the western expedition, and the operations in Zhao and in Yan.
kits: 卡面的亞述長弓是公元前七世紀兩河流域的長反曲複合弓，木、角、筋三層合製，貼角處強而少彈，貼筋處柔而有韌，握把纏皮，箭長近丈，射得遠而準；亞述人把它架在車上，弓兵在車中放箭，車兵跟在他們後面推進，弓與鐵同時到位，才把兩河平原逐城拿下。卡面兵器不在秦軍序列之內，但它所代表的路線在秦軍那裡有更進步的對應物。弩是秦軍的中距離主兵器，秦弩以銅製弩機，張力儲於弩臂，扣機而發，數十步至百步之內命中穩定，秦始皇陵陪葬坑出土的銅弩機殘件即是實物憑證；弓則為木竹複合弓，貼牛角與筋，與亞述弓同屬「以角筋加固木胎」的路線，只是工料與形制都更小更省。矛、戈、戟是秦軍的近戰骨幹，長柄戈由秦戟演化，刃部青銅或鐵，裝在木柲上。兵車是秦軍的骨架，單軛雙輪，車上通常四人：御者居中執韁，射手居左持弩或弓，右側兩人持戈矛，正是「弓兵開路、車兵跟進」的亞洲版；秦始皇陵出土的實戰車俑即是此制。防護用皮甲、札甲與銅甲片；攻城靠雲梯、巢車與楯車；運輸靠牛車，糧食多沿渭水、鴻溝與汝水轉運。
kitsEn: The Assyrian bow on the card is the long recurve composite bow of Mesopotamia from the seventh century BC, built in three layers of wood, horn and sinew, stiffened with horn where the bow had to carry power and braced with sinew where it had to bend, with a leather-wrapped grip, arrows close to a fathom long, and a range both long and accurate. The Assyrians set it up on the chariot, with the archers loosing their arrows from the platform and the fighting men advancing behind them; bow and iron arrived at the same time, and it was that combination that took the Mesopotamian plain city by city. The weapon on the card was not in the Qin order of battle, but the line of technique it stands for has a more advanced counterpart in the Qin army. The crossbow was the Qin missile weapon of the middle range; the Qin crossbow used a bronze trigger mechanism, storing the tension in the arms so that a squeeze of the trigger released it, and it hit reliably from several tens of paces to a hundred; the bronze trigger fittings excavated from the accessory pits of the mausoleum of the First Emperor are the material proof of this. The bow itself was a wood-and-bamboo composite bow reinforced with horn and sinew, belonging to the same family as the Assyrian bow, the road of strengthening a wooden core with horn and sinew, only smaller and cheaper in both material and form. Spear, ge and ji formed the close-combat backbone of the Qin army, the long-shafted ge of the Qin having grown out of the dagger-axe, its blade in bronze or iron and socketed on a wooden shaft. The war chariot was the skeleton of the Qin army, a single draught pole with two wheels, usually carrying four men: the driver in the middle holding the reins, the archer on the left with a crossbow or a bow, and two men with ge and spear on the right, which is the Asian version of the very principle of archers opening the way and the chariot following them; the fighting chariot figurines excavated at the mausoleum of the First Emperor show exactly this establishment. Protection was by leather armour, by lamellar armour and by bronze plates; siege work used scaling ladders, tower carts and mantlets; transport was by ox cart, and grain was moved largely along the Wei river, the Honggou canal and the Ru river.
tactics: 起義軍的戰術可以概括為三句：暴起、驅眾、速攻。暴雨阻路、期限將至的幾日之內，九百戍卒在夜裡以狐鳴魚腹造勢，殺死尉與守丞而奪其令，裹挾沿途百姓同行，旬月之間聚起數萬人直撲陳郡；攻城靠人數與聲勢，不靠器械，陳郡守令不在、守丞已死，城中無主，遂一鼓而入。奪城之後分兵四路是必然之舉，因為陳郡只是天下的一角，陳涉必須靠分兵去博取更多郡縣。但分兵立刻暴露出致命弱點：周文孤軍西進關中，糧道被拉長到數百里之外，沿途只能靠徵發關中百姓供應，士卒多而訓練少、器械不足，一旦失去突發的士氣便迅速潰散；秦將章邯的應對正是各個擊破：先在曹陽擊破周文大軍，再回師攻陳，同年之內壓平陳郡。起義軍在佔領區沒有留下守備與屯田，沒有儲備的糧秣與城防，攻擊與後方互相脫節，這是它無法把陳郡變成根據地的技術原因。
tacticsEn: The tactics of the rebels can be summed up in three phrases: sudden outbreak, massing of the people, and a fast assault. During the days when the rain had blocked the road and the deadline was closing in, the nine hundred conscripts worked on the crowd by night with the fox's cry and the writing in the fish, killed the commandant and the assistant officer and took their tokens, and drew the villagers of the road along with them; within a month they had gathered tens of thousands and struck at the commandery of Chen. The assault on the city rested on numbers and on the impression of momentum rather than on siege engines; the magistrate of Chen was away and the assistant officer was dead, so the city had no one in command and fell at the first push. Splitting the army into four columns after the capture was a necessity, for Chen was only one corner of the empire and Chen Sheng had to gamble on more commanderies. But the split exposed the fatal weakness at once. Zhou Wen marched west into Guanzhong alone, with his supply line stretched for several hundred li and subsisting on requisitions from the people of Guanzhong along the way; he had many men, few of them trained, and too little equipment, and the moment the initial momentum was lost he dissolved. The answer of the Qin general Zhang Han was to beat each column in turn: first he broke Zhou Wen at Caoyang, then he turned back and attacked Chen, and within that same year the commandery of Chen was put down. The rebels left no garrison and no fields behind them, no grain laid up and no fortifications, and the attack and the rear were disconnected from each other. That is the technical reason why Chen never became a base.
data: 可核對的數字分三類。第一類是《史記·陳涉世家》所記的內證：起義的戍卒是九百人，屬屯戍漁陽的隊伍；陳涉、吳廣「行收兵」，旬月之間到陳時「車六七百乘，騎千餘，卒數萬人」；周文將兵出關，「兵數十萬」；起義的時間是秦二世元年七月，即公元前209年七月，與秦人自認的「失期法皆斬」相合。地理距離亦可核：大澤鄉在泗水之濱，屬泗水郡，今屬江蘇宿遷一帶，至陳郡治所淮陽約五百里；曹陽在陳郡西南、今河南汝陽東，章邯自關中出，經洛陽、潁川而至，與陳郡相距約三四百里。第二類是秦朝兵力結構的數字：蒙恬將三十萬眾北擊匈奴、戍上郡與九原；平定嶺南後發兵五十萬戍五嶺；《史記》記天下徒送至驪山修陵與諸工程者七十餘萬人，兵員雖多，能戰者只居其一角。第三類是考古數字：秦始皇陵兵馬俑坑出土實戰車俑數十輛、陶俑數千，銅弩機、箭鏃、戈矛與甲片成組出土；湖北雲夢睡虎地秦簡與湖南里耶秦簡，保存了秦郡縣公文與編年，是核對秦軍行政與後勤的原始材料。
dataEn: The checkable figures fall into three classes. The first is the internal evidence preserved in the chapter on the House of Chen Sheng in the Records of the Grand Historian. The conscripts who rose numbered nine hundred and belonged to the column garrisoned at Yuanyang; Chen Sheng and Wu Guang gathered people as they marched, and by the time they reached Chen there were six or seven hundred carts, a thousand and more horsemen and tens of thousands of foot. Zhou Wen took his army out of the passes with several tens of thousands of men. The rising is dated to the seventh month of the first year of the Second Emperor, that is July of 209 BC, which fits the Qin regulation that a column missing its deadline was to be executed. Distances can be checked as well. Daze township lay on the Si river in the commandery of Si, in the region of Suqian in Jiangsu today, some five hundred li from the seat of the commandery of Chen at Huaiyang; Caoyang lay to the south-west of that commandery, in what is now Ruyang in Henan to the east, and Zhang Han came out of Guanzhong by way of Luoyang and Yingchuan, some three or four hundred li from Chen. The second class is the set of numbers describing the structure of the Qin army: Meng Tian took three hundred thousand men north against the Xiongnu and garrisoned Shangjun and Jiuyuan; after the pacification of Lingnan fifty thousand men were sent to garrison the Five Ridges; and the Records of the Grand Historian speaks of more than seven hundred thousand convicts and labourers sent from all over the empire to the works at Lishan and the tomb. The troops were numerous, but only a fraction of them could actually fight. The third class is archaeological. The pit of the terracotta warriors at the mausoleum of the First Emperor has yielded several dozen fighting chariot figurines, several thousand infantry figurines, and sets of bronze trigger fittings, arrowheads, ge and spears, and armour plates; the Qin slips from Yunmeng in Hubei and the Qin slips from Liye in Hunan preserve the documents and the annals of the commanderies and counties, and are the original material for checking the administration and the logistics of the Qin army.
cause: 秦末的亂局有四層推力。第一層是徭役與兵役的總量：北築長城與九原，南開靈渠與五嶺，東逐強韓魏，宮室、苑囿與驪山陵又動用刑徒，男子被徵到北方與東南，女子不勝其力，粟米布帛不給。第二層是秦法的嚴苛與不體恤人：戍卒九百人的小隊因雨阻路而失期，按律當斬，沒有申辯的餘地；郡縣官員只求保結，秦廷以急功近利治天下。第三層是政治上的自殘：秦始皇末年已在沙丘毒殺扶蘇、蒙恬，二世又誅蒙毅，屯守上郡的邊軍三十萬頓時無主，朝中人人自危，趙高以中尉之權秉政，殺戮的訊號傳到每一個郡縣。第四層是舊世界的崩潰與新秩序的未穩：六國被滅不過十數年，舊貴族、舊官吏與民間的復仇記憶仍在，郡縣制尚無足夠的時間生根。公元前209年七月的暴雨只是導火線，真正點火的是失期當斬的絕望，以及「王侯將相寧有種乎」的吶喊。
causeEn: Four pushes lay behind the disorder of the end of the Qin. The first was the sheer weight of labour service and military service: the wall and the camps of Jiuyuan in the north, the Lingqu and the Five Ridges in the south, the campaigns against Han and Wei in the east, the palaces, the hunting parks and the tomb of Lishan, all worked by convicts; the men were taken off to the north and the south, the women could not bear the strain, and grain and cloth did not suffice. The second was the harshness of Qin law and its indifference to men: a small column of nine hundred conscripts that lost its way in the rain would be executed on the deadline with no chance to argue, and the commandery and county officials cared only for their reports, while the court governed the empire by pressing for quick results. The third was political self-mutilation. At Shaqiu at the end of the First Emperor's reign Fusu and Meng Tian were put to death, and the Second Emperor then executed Meng Yi; the thirty thousand men garrisoned at Shangjun on the frontier were at once without a general, everyone at court was on edge, and Zhao Gao, holding the authority of the commandant of justice, directed the government, so that the signal of killing reached every commandery and county. The fourth was the collapse of the old world and the failure of the new order to take root. The six kingdoms had been destroyed a mere ten-odd years before; the memory of the old nobles, the old officials and the revenge of the common people was still alive, and the commandery-and-county system had not had time to grow deep roots. The rain of July 209 BC was only the fuse; what actually lit the powder was the despair of men facing execution for a missed deadline, and the cry that kings and nobles were not born of a special breed.
impact: 這場起義的結果是秦朝覆亡，但它留下的東西比秦朝更長。第一，它終結了秦的軍事優勢：秦軍以兵數與兵器之利維持的秩序，一夜之間被數萬農民軍在陳郡掀開；秦廷從此只剩關中與部分郡縣，二世在位不到兩年即被趙高逼死，子嬰出降，十五年的秦朝終結，楚漢戰爭隨即展開。第二，它把秦的制度遺產交給了漢：郡縣制、書同文、度量衡與車同軌的標準，二十等爵與軍功爵的框架，以及秦軍的編制、兵器與工藝，被劉邦與漢廷全數承襲，漢承秦制不是一句空話。第三，它改變了中國歷史的敘事結構：此後王朝更替總要經過「起義、平亂、新政」的三段式，「揭竿而起」與「王侯將相寧有種乎」成為亂世的口號，陳涉雖死於下城父，其名號與「張楚」卻成為後世起義者自立的模板。第四，它在考古上打開了秦代軍事的細節：兵馬俑坑的實戰車俑、銅弩機與甲片，讓研究者第一次看見秦軍的車、弩、戈在同一編制內如何配合；睡虎地與里耶的秦簡，則讓後人讀到郡縣徵兵與文書運作的實況。
impactEn: The rising ended the Qin, but what it left behind outlasted the Qin. First, it broke the military superiority of the Qin state. The order that the Qin army held together by weight of numbers and quality of arms was torn open in the commandery of Chen in a single night by tens of thousands of peasants; the court was left with the capital and a few commanderies, the Second Emperor was forced to death by Zhao Gao before he had ruled two years, Ziying surrendered, and the fifteen years of the Qin came to an end, with the Chu-Han war opening at once behind them. Second, it handed the institutional inheritance of the Qin to the Han: the commandery-and-county system, the uniform script, the standards of weights, measures and axle widths, the framework of the twenty ranks and of military merit ranks, together with the organisation, the arms and the craft of the Qin army, were all taken over by Liu Bang and his court. That the Han took over the Qin system is not an empty phrase. Third, it changed the narrative structure of Chinese history. From then on the founding of a dynasty always ran through the three stages of rising, suppression and new government; the raising of bamboo poles and the cry that kings and nobles were not born of a special breed became the slogans of troubled times, and although Chen Sheng died at Xiachengfu, his name and his title Zhangchu became the template by which later insurgents set themselves up. Fourth, it opened the details of Qin military affairs to archaeology for the first time. The fighting chariot figurines, the bronze trigger fittings and the armour plates of the terracotta pit allow scholars to see for the first time how the chariot, the crossbow and the ge worked together within one establishment, and the Qin slips from Yunmeng and Liye let later readers see the actual operation of the levies and of the documents of the commanderies.
result: 公元前209年七月到同年年底，這場戰爭經歷了一個完整的攻守翻轉。陳涉、吳廣由大澤鄉起事，旬月之間以數萬之眾攻下陳郡，建立「張楚」政權，分兵四路；周文西向關中一度聚起數十萬人，把關中的郡縣逼到戒嚴。章邯以秦將身分出關迎擊，先在曹陽擊破周文，再回師攻陳，陳涉敗走，途中死於下城父，張楚政權隨之瓦解，陳郡重歸秦軍之手。此後章邯逐路平定，趙地、燕地、楚地的反秦力量在各自的地方領袖帶領下殘存並壯大，兩年後反而在鉅鹿之戰重創秦軍主力，秦朝才真正走向崩潰。就公元前209年這一段而言，結果是清楚的：秦軍以裝備優勢與調度能力保住了陳郡與關中，起義軍則以爆發力席捲三郡而未能佔領任何一城。雙方的失敗原因也對稱：秦輸在失去地方社會的信任與正當性，起義輸在沒有編制、後方與可持續的糧秣。
resultEn: From July 209 BC to the end of that year this war went through a complete reversal of attack and defence. Chen Sheng and Wu Guang rose at Daze township and within a month had taken the commandery of Chen with tens of thousands of men, established the regime of Zhangchu, and split their forces into four columns. Zhou Wen marched west into Guanzhong and at one point gathered several tens of thousands, forcing the commanderies of Guanzhong onto a war footing. Zhang Han, as a general of the Qin, marched out of the passes to meet him, first broke Zhou Wen at Caoyang, and then turned back and attacked Chen. Chen Sheng was defeated and withdrew, and was killed on the way at Xiachengfu; the Zhangchu regime fell apart, and Chen came back into the hands of the Qin army. Zhang Han then pacified the country column by column, and the anti-Qin forces in Zhao, in Yan and in Chu survived under their own local leaders and grew stronger, and two years later they destroyed the main Qin army at the battle of Julu, and only then did the Qin really move towards collapse. As for the part of the war that falls in 209 BC, the outcome is plain: the Qin army saved the commandery of Chen and the capital by its equipment and by its command, while the rebel army, for all its speed, swept three commanderies and held not one city. The two failures were symmetrical. The Qin lost the trust of local society and its legitimacy; the rebels lacked an establishment, a rear area and a supply that could be sustained.
